title: R6F exact-preserving structural inference matrix

program_alignment.central_question: Can an exact-preserving refactorization remove enough short-loop pathology from the R6D likelihood graph to make ordinary sum product a credible posterior approximation?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: structural algorithm experiment after R6E rejected ordinary loopy BP on the unclustered graph
program_alignment.upstream_evidence: R6D proves the nonnegative likelihood identity; R6E verifies exact messages but finds convergence failure, hard-message contradictions, and large primitive marginal bias
program_alignment.downstream_gate: no correction or LER sampling until an exact-preserving graph representation is compared against exact primitive marginals

question.research_question: Are the R6E failures primarily caused by redundant short loops in the exact R6D auxiliary-flow factorization, and how much is recovered by bounded local factor clustering?
question.smallest_claim: Descriptive convergence and exact-marginal error on the same registered 12-edge primitive controls only.
question.H1: bounded exact-preserving superfactor clustering improves convergence or marginal accuracy relative to the matched R6E unclustered baseline
question.H2: the exact global physical-likelihood factor reproduces primitive exact marginals, separating message-engine correctness from loopy-factorization error
question.H3: bounded clustering remains biased or nonconvergent, rejecting this specific refactorization as an exact posterior solver
question.falsification: failure of either clustered or global factors to reproduce the R6D likelihood table rejects the construction before any BP comparison; global-factor marginal error above 1e-8 rejects the inference implementation

representations: r6e_unclustered: reuse the frozen 32-row R6E baseline without new computation
bounded_superfactor: merge both colour pin factors on every edge and merge the observation plus both colour-flow factors at every vertex; exact, nonnegative, maximum arity nine, and O(E+V) factors
global_physical_ceiling: exactly contract all auxiliary flows into one 12-edge likelihood factor; a factor tree on the primitive graph but explicitly non-scalable
matrix.controls: reuse the four deterministic R6E observations selected by candidate-count strata, p in {0.10,0.30}, and both local-only and finite terminal-screened modes
matrix.exact_targets: enumerate all 4096 physical masks and analytically contract R6D auxiliary flows
matrix.identity_gate: exhaustively compare clustered and global factor products with the R6D local likelihood on every physical mask for one registered observation in each graph mode
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; zero correction, LER, threshold, or performance samples

primary_metrics: maximum and mean physical-edge marginal absolute error
analysis.branch_logic: an identity failure blocks BP; an exact global ceiling with failed bounded clustering localizes the remaining problem to loopy bounded inference rather than the R6D likelihood or message arithmetic
analysis.terminal_logic: local-only and terminal-screened modes remain separate; the global terminal projector is not relabelled as a local factor

acceptance_items.item: exact-preserving bounded and global graph builders plus identity tests
acceptance_items.evidence: scripts/d4_local_bp.py and scripts/test_r6f_structural_inference_matrix.py; zero local product-table and global likelihood-table error

acceptance_items.item: matched primitive marginal matrix against frozen R6E baseline
acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6f-structural-inference-matrix.json; bounded clustering converges 8/32 with 0/32 exact, global ceiling converges and is exact on 32/32

acceptance_items.item: analysis, tests, report, roadmap, and durable-state update
acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6f-structural-inference-matrix.md; Plan, Report, Wiki roadmap/log, Lab metadata, and state updated; 2 focused and 145 full Lab tests, Wiki lint, and 12 knowledge-graph tests pass. Node dashboard tests pass 27/28; the sole failure is the pre-existing unmarked-math fixture in Lab 001 REPORT.md, outside R6F scope.

claim_boundary: R6F cannot establish scalable convergence, decoding quality, a polynomial-time decoder, logical performance, threshold, or fault tolerance. The global physical factor is an exact finite ceiling, not a scalable proposal.
